name: cradle-text
title: Cradle Text
description: Letters hang from a rail like a Newton's cradle: the first is pulled out and released, the knock runs through the row and the last letter swings out.
useWhen: A short word should behave like a desk toy: physical, playful, with a clear cause and effect.
A title needs a satisfying ball-and-string beat.
avoidWhen: Long text: the cradle needs a single short line.
A calm, premium entrance: use per-character-rise.
author: Kokonut UI

variables.label: Text
variables.description: One short line of letters hung from the rail.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Maximum text size in pixels. Longer text shrinks to fit the frame.

variables.label: Rail color
variables.description: Color of the rail and the threads.

variables.label: Bounce
variables.description: How much speed a collision keeps, 0 to 1. Steel is about 0.95.

variables.label: Pull angle
variables.description: How far the first letter is pulled out, in radians.

variables.label: Pull at
variables.description: Second the first letter is pulled out.
